Question Choices: There are 253 jelly beans in each jar. Your mother buys you and your friends 27 jars . How many jelly beans did she buy in total?
Hints: Multiply by ones, tens and hundreds separately. Keep carries and partial products in their correct columns.
Solution: 253 x 27: 253 x 7 = 1771; 253 x 20 = 5060. Add partial products: 1771 + 5060 = 6831. Answer: 6831 jelly beans.
